_meta.note: 一個任務一個檔。改完跑 tools/quest-bundle.py。

The Canary Calls#000.src: Find out what's happening at the {p} coal mine at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Canary Calls#001.src: Phew... Everyone make it out alright? That was...one hell of a sprint. I'm absolutely knackered.
The Canary Calls#001.dst: 휴... 다들 무사히 나왔지? 진짜... 죽어라 뛰었네. 완전 녹초야.
The Canary Calls#001.speaker: Daffyd

The Canary Calls#002.src: I'm not sure, mate. I left a bunch of my stuff down there. Who knows if I'll get it back.
The Canary Calls#002.dst: 글쎄다, 친구. 내 물건 잔뜩 두고 왔는데. 다시 찾을 수 있을지 모르겠어.
The Canary Calls#002.speaker: Micho

The Canary Calls#003.src: Forget about that, what are we gonna tell the chief? That chopsy old fool is gonna kill us if he sees us not working.
The Canary Calls#003.dst: 그건 잊어. 반장한테 뭐라고 하지? 일 안 하는 거 보면 그 입 험한 영감이 우릴 죽일 거야.
The Canary Calls#003.speaker: Daffyd

The Canary Calls#004.src: Oi, you! Listen, there was some kind of explosion down in the mines. We're not sure what it is or where it came from, but it surely didn't sound good.
The Canary Calls#004.dst: 어이, 거기! 들어 봐, 탄광 아래서 폭발 같은 게 있었어. 뭔지, 어디서 났는지 모르지만 소리가 영 안 좋았어.
The Canary Calls#004.speaker: Daffyd

The Canary Calls#005.src: The four of us were the only blokes down in the mines, so everyone should be out safely. But I reckon we can't go back if this issue isn't resolved.
The Canary Calls#005.dst: 탄광 아래엔 우리 넷뿐이었으니 다들 무사히 나왔을 거야. 근데 이 문제가 안 풀리면 다시 못 들어가.
The Canary Calls#005.speaker: Daffyd

The Canary Calls#006.src: You must go to the chief and tell him about the situation. Head down this mineshaft and turn left, and he should be there.
The Canary Calls#006.dst: 반장한테 가서 상황을 전해 줘. 이 갱도로 내려가서 왼쪽으로 돌면 반장이 있을 거야.
The Canary Calls#006.speaker: Daffyd

The Canary Calls#007.src: Just, uh... Make sure not to mention us by name. Now, if you'll excuse us, we'll...be on our way.
The Canary Calls#007.dst: 그리고, 어... 우리 이름은 꼭 빼 줘. 그럼 우린 이만... 가 볼게.
The Canary Calls#007.speaker: Daffyd

The Canary Calls#008.src: Turn left from the mine's entrance and speak to the chief at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
The Canary Calls#008.dst: 탄광 입구에서 왼쪽으로 돌아 [{~}, {~}, -{~}]의 반장과 대화하세요.

The Canary Calls#009.src: That's right, keep it moving! The whole of {p} is going to run out of coal at this pace!
The Canary Calls#009.dst: 그래, 손 멈추지 마! 이 속도면 {p} 전체에 석탄이 동나겠다!
The Canary Calls#009.speaker: Chief Clight

The Canary Calls#010.src: Eh? What do you want? Only registered miners are allowed beyond this point. Speak up or get off the premises.
The Canary Calls#010.dst: 응? 무슨 용건이야? 여기부턴 등록된 광부만 들어갈 수 있어. 할 말 있으면 하고 아니면 나가.
The Canary Calls#010.speaker: Chief Clight

The Canary Calls#011.src: ...An explosion? In the mines? Just now?
The Canary Calls#011.speaker: Chief Clight

The Canary Calls#012.src: EMERGENCY BREAK TIME, YOU GERBILS! EVERYONE COME AND MEET ME BY THE ENTRANCE! NOW!!!
The Canary Calls#012.dst: 긴급 휴식이다, 이 게르빌 녀석들아! 전원 입구로 모여! 당장!!!
The Canary Calls#012.speaker: Chief Clight

The Canary Calls#013.src: Alright, you lot better listen bloody carefully. An explosion has been reported in the mines. You all know what that means, yes?
The Canary Calls#013.dst: 좋아, 다들 똑똑히 들어. 탄광에서 폭발이 있었다는 보고가 들어왔다. 그게 무슨 뜻인지 알지?
The Canary Calls#013.speaker: Chief Clight

The Canary Calls#018.src: No, you bunch of ingrates! One of you needs to take the ol' canary down to the mines and see whatever the hell's going on.
The Canary Calls#018.dst: 아니, 이 배은망덕한 놈들아! 누구 하나가 카나리아를 데리고 내려가서 무슨 일인지 봐야 해.
The Canary Calls#018.speaker: Chief Clight

The Canary Calls#019.src: Now, which one of you blokes would be willing to-
The Canary Calls#019.speaker: Chief Clight

The Canary Calls#021.src: Right then. I guess that leaves you, young lad. What do you say? Want a job?
The Canary Calls#021.dst: 그렇군. 그럼 남은 건 너뿐이구나, 젊은이. 어때? 일자리 필요해?
The Canary Calls#021.speaker: Chief Clight

The Canary Calls#022.src: Very good! Come on then, let me introduce you to our little feathered mascot.
The Canary Calls#022.dst: 아주 좋아! 그럼 따라와, 우리 깃털 달린 마스코트를 소개해 주지.
The Canary Calls#022.speaker: Chief Clight

The Canary Calls#023.src: You sure? I'll pay a lot, and it won't be dangerous. Even if it is, you've got all that armor on you!
The Canary Calls#023.dst: 정말? 돈 두둑이 줄게, 위험하지도 않아. 위험해도 너한텐 그 갑옷이 있잖아!
The Canary Calls#023.speaker: Chief Clight

The Canary Calls#024.src: That's the spirit! Come on then, let me introduce you to our little feathered mascot.
The Canary Calls#024.dst: 바로 그거야! 그럼 따라와, 우리 깃털 달린 마스코트를 소개해 주지.
The Canary Calls#024.speaker: Chief Clight

The Canary Calls#025.src: You'll get a bloody mountain of emeralds, god damn it! This is a once in a lifetime opportunity! Do you want it or not?
The Canary Calls#025.dst: 빌어먹을 에메랄드를 산더미만큼 받는다고! 평생 한 번 올 기회야! 할 거야, 말 거야?
The Canary Calls#025.speaker: Chief Clight

The Canary Calls#026.src: Good. Now, hurry up and follow me.
The Canary Calls#026.speaker: Chief Clight

The Canary Calls#027.src: You know what? This is ridiculous. The whole of {p} is at danger, and you're playing games with ME?! I know you can do it. Follow me. Now.
The Canary Calls#027.dst: 있잖아, 이건 말도 안 돼. {p} 전체가 위험한데 나랑 장난해?! 넌 할 수 있어. 따라와. 당장.
The Canary Calls#027.speaker: Chief Clight

The Canary Calls#028.src: Scared speechless, eh? Don't worry, it'll be an easy job. Come on, follow me to the canary's cage.
The Canary Calls#028.dst: 겁먹어서 말도 안 나와? 걱정 마, 쉬운 일이야. 자, 카나리아 새장까지 따라와.
The Canary Calls#028.speaker: Chief Clight

The Canary Calls#029.src: Meet our canary! She's such a beaut.
The Canary Calls#029.speaker: Chief Clight

The Canary Calls#030.src: You see, whenever we hear news of an explosion we always bring our canary with us to check it out. They can detect potential gases much earlier than we can.
The Canary Calls#030.dst: 폭발 소식이 들리면 우린 늘 카나리아를 데리고 확인하러 가. 카나리아는 가스를 우리보다 훨씬 먼저 알아채거든.
The Canary Calls#030.speaker: Chief Clight

The Canary Calls#031.src: Let me just get the key and-
The Canary Calls#031.speaker: Chief Clight

The Canary Calls#032.src: WAIT, WHAT? WHERE'S THE BLOODY KEY? WHICH ONE OF YOUR LOT IS RESPONSIBLE?! I SWEAR I'M GONNA...
The Canary Calls#032.dst: 잠깐, 뭐야? 빌어먹을 열쇠 어디 갔어? 어느 놈 짓이야?! 맹세컨대 내가...
The Canary Calls#032.speaker: Chief Clight

The Canary Calls#033.src: ...Listen up, lad. Take this toothpick I've been chewing on. I need you to pick the cage's lock. It's a little wet, but it should do the trick. Understood? Good, now hurry up!
The Canary Calls#033.dst: ...잘 들어, 젊은이. 내가 씹던 이쑤시개를 줄게. 이걸로 새장 자물쇠를 따 줘. 좀 축축하지만 될 거야. 알겠지? 좋아, 서둘러!
The Canary Calls#033.speaker: Chief Clight

The Canary Calls#035.src: Doing just fine, lad. Almost there...
The Canary Calls#035.dst: 잘하고 있어, 젊은이. 거의 다 됐어...
The Canary Calls#035.speaker: Chief Clight

The Canary Calls#036.src: Little old birdie is getting quite excited! Keep it up.
The Canary Calls#036.speaker: Chief Clight

The Canary Calls#037.src: Right then, lad! It's time to begin the-
The Canary Calls#037.speaker: Chief Clight

The Canary Calls#038.src: OW! Bloody hell! Those are some freakishly sharp claws! What are you playing at-
The Canary Calls#038.dst: 아야! 빌어먹을! 발톱 한번 섬뜩하게 날카롭네! 뭐 하자는-
The Canary Calls#038.speaker: Chief Clight

The Canary Calls#039.src: Well, I think she likes you, lad. Doesn't like me, apparently.
The Canary Calls#039.dst: 음, 널 좋아하는 것 같네, 젊은이. 나는 싫어하나 봐.
The Canary Calls#039.speaker: Chief Clight

The Canary Calls#040.src: I was going to feed her, but I suppose you can do the honors. Or not, seeing as she's been particularly troublesome...
The Canary Calls#040.dst: 내가 먹이를 주려 했는데 그 영광은 너한테 양보하지. 아니면 말고. 오늘따라 유난히 말썽이니까...
The Canary Calls#040.speaker: Chief Clight

The Canary Calls#041.src: Anyway, do as you please. I'll be waiting by the elevator in the mineshaft. Hurry up, and don't make me wait!
The Canary Calls#041.dst: 아무튼, 마음대로 해. 갱도 승강기 옆에서 기다리지. 서둘러, 기다리게 하지 마!
The Canary Calls#041.speaker: Chief Clight

The Canary Calls#042.src: Head to the mine elevator at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Canary Calls#043.src: Right then, lad! I suppose you might want to know more about this job.
The Canary Calls#043.dst: 좋아, 젊은이! 이 일에 대해 좀 더 알고 싶겠지.
The Canary Calls#043.speaker: Chief Clight

The Canary Calls#044.src: As I said before, when unknown explosions occur in the mines, that's usually a sign that something bad happened.
The Canary Calls#044.dst: 아까 말했듯이, 탄광에서 정체 모를 폭발이 나면 보통 뭔가 안 좋은 일이 생겼다는 뜻이야.
The Canary Calls#044.speaker: Chief Clight

The Canary Calls#045.src: Most of the time, an awfully putrid gas appears. This is where our canary comes in. Once she verifies that a gas is present, we decide whether or not to temporarily close the mine.
The Canary Calls#045.dst: 대개 지독하게 썩은 냄새 나는 가스가 나와. 여기서 카나리아가 나서지. 가스가 있다고 확인되면 탄광을 잠시 닫을지 정해.
The Canary Calls#045.speaker: Chief Clight

The Canary Calls#046.src: I presume you met Daffyd and his group, correct? Thankfully, they were the only ones down in the mines.
The Canary Calls#046.dst: Daffyd 일행은 만났지? 다행히 탄광 아래엔 그 녀석들뿐이었어.
The Canary Calls#046.speaker: Chief Clight

The Canary Calls#047.src: ...Wait, where the hell even are they? Did I not tell them to...
The Canary Calls#047.dst: ...잠깐, 그 녀석들 대체 어디 갔어? 내가 분명...
The Canary Calls#047.speaker: Chief Clight

The Canary Calls#048.src: Eh, doesn't matter. Lad, point is, I want you to check whether the gas is still there, if at all.
The Canary Calls#048.dst: 에이, 상관없어. 젊은이, 요점은 가스가 아직 남아 있는지 확인해 달라는 거야.
The Canary Calls#048.speaker: Chief Clight

The Canary Calls#049.src: We'll use the elevator behind me to get down to the mines. Just let me pull this here lever to activate it...
The Canary Calls#049.dst: 내 뒤의 승강기로 탄광에 내려갈 거야. 이 레버만 당겨서 작동시키면...
The Canary Calls#049.speaker: Chief Clight

The Canary Calls#050.src: ...WHY ISN'T THIS BLOODY CONTRAPTION WORKING??! WORK, WORK, GOD DAMN IT!!
The Canary Calls#050.dst: ...이 빌어먹을 고물은 왜 안 움직여??! 움직여, 움직이라고, 젠장!!
The Canary Calls#050.speaker: Chief Clight

The Canary Calls#051.src: Must've been Daffyd and his group... No worries, lad. I've got, uh... a last resort, so to speak.
The Canary Calls#051.dst: Daffyd 일행 짓이겠군... 걱정 마, 젊은이. 나한텐, 어... 말하자면 최후의 수단이 있어.
The Canary Calls#051.speaker: Chief Clight

The Canary Calls#052.src: You'll need to ride a minecart down into the mines. Thing is, we haven't used them to transport people in...years.
The Canary Calls#052.dst: 광차를 타고 탄광에 내려가야 해. 문제는 사람 태운 지가... 몇 년 됐다는 거지.
The Canary Calls#052.speaker: Chief Clight

The Canary Calls#053.src: Why? Erm, well... See for yourself.
The Canary Calls#053.speaker: Chief Clight

The Canary Calls#054.src: Our transporter minecarts are manual. Miners around here prefer automatic.
The Canary Calls#054.dst: 우리 운반용 광차는 수동이야. 여기 광부들은 자동을 좋아하거든.
The Canary Calls#054.speaker: Chief Clight

The Canary Calls#055.src: For you, it should be no issue controlling it. There's instructions attached to the gear stick.
The Canary Calls#055.dst: 너라면 조작하는 데 문제없을 거야. 변속 레버에 설명서가 붙어 있어.
The Canary Calls#055.speaker: Chief Clight

The Canary Calls#056.src: Now then, go into the mineshaft, following the rails behind me. You'll be able to summon a minecart there.
The Canary Calls#056.dst: 자, 내 뒤의 선로를 따라 갱도로 들어가. 거기서 광차를 부를 수 있어.
The Canary Calls#056.speaker: Chief Clight

The Canary Calls#057.src: Use the rails to get to the gas leakage.
The Canary Calls#057.dst: 선로를 이용해 가스 누출 지점으로 가세요.

The Canary Calls#058.src: Follow the rail tracks and find a way to escape the mine
The Canary Calls#058.dst: 선로를 따라가 탄광을 빠져나갈 방법을 찾으세요

The Canary Calls#059.src: Continue further in the mine to find a way out.
The Canary Calls#059.dst: 탄광 더 깊이 들어가 출구를 찾으세요.

The Canary Calls#062.src: I am but a figment of your imagination. To you, I am not real.
The Canary Calls#062.dst: 난 당신 상상의 산물일 뿐. 당신에겐 진짜가 아니죠.
The Canary Calls#062.speaker: Canary

The Canary Calls#063.src: The mysterious force that brought death upon me... It changed me.
The Canary Calls#063.dst: 내게 죽음을 가져온 그 기묘한 힘이... 날 바꿔 놓았어요.
The Canary Calls#063.speaker: Canary

The Canary Calls#064.src: So too will it change you. I will make that happen. Just for you.
The Canary Calls#064.dst: 당신도 바꿔 놓을 거예요. 내가 그렇게 만들게요. 당신만을 위해.
The Canary Calls#064.speaker: Canary

The Canary Calls#065.src: No need to thank me. It is the least I can do.
The Canary Calls#065.dst: 고마워할 필요 없어요. 이 정도는 해야죠.
The Canary Calls#065.speaker: Canary

The Canary Calls#066.src: Moments like these are cherished. Savor the moment with me. Would you like to die with me?
The Canary Calls#066.dst: 이런 순간은 소중하죠. 나와 함께 음미해요. 나와 함께 죽을래요?
The Canary Calls#066.speaker: Canary

The Canary Calls#067.src: I see. So you want to make this an unforgettable experience. I appreciate the thoughtfulness.
The Canary Calls#067.dst: 그렇군요. 잊지 못할 경험으로 만들고 싶은 거군요. 그 배려, 고마워요.
The Canary Calls#067.speaker: Canary

The Canary Calls#069.src: I was hoping we could stay for a little longer. If that is your choice, then so be it.
The Canary Calls#069.dst: 조금 더 머물길 바랐는데. 그게 당신의 선택이라면, 그렇게 하죠.
The Canary Calls#069.speaker: Canary

The Canary Calls#070.src: See you on the other side.
The Canary Calls#070.speaker: Canary

The Canary Calls#071.src: I would be more than glad to. Sit back and relax.
The Canary Calls#071.speaker: Canary

The Canary Calls#073.src: Mine could have been better. Cramped up in a cage all day, then suddenly witnessing my death in front of an incompetent human.
The Canary Calls#073.dst: 난 별로였어요. 종일 새장에 갇혀 있다가, 무능한 인간 앞에서 갑자기 내 죽음을 봤거든요.
The Canary Calls#073.speaker: Canary

The Canary Calls#074.src: You couldn't even save me. How pathetic.
The Canary Calls#074.speaker: Canary

The Canary Calls#075.src: So, anyway, do you come here often?
The Canary Calls#075.speaker: Canary

The Canary Calls#076.src: Oh, wait. This is your first time. As well as your last time. That's very poetic. Do you want to become a poet?
The Canary Calls#076.dst: 아, 잠깐. 이번이 처음이죠. 그리고 마지막이고요. 참 시적이네요. 시인이 되고 싶어요?
The Canary Calls#076.speaker: Canary

The Canary Calls#077.src: I know a good poem. Want to hear it?
The Canary Calls#077.speaker: Canary

The Canary Calls#085.src: You will lose a lot of things,
The Canary Calls#085.speaker: Canary

The Canary Calls#100.src: The most average Joe I've seen,
The Canary Calls#100.speaker: Canary

The Canary Calls#102.src: How was that? It was beautiful, wasn't it?
The Canary Calls#102.speaker: Canary

The Canary Calls#103.src: Silence is bliss. You must not have very many friends.
The Canary Calls#103.dst: 침묵은 금이죠. 친구가 별로 없나 봐요.
The Canary Calls#103.speaker: Canary

The Canary Calls#104.src: That's okay. I am your friend. Am I your friend? Please say yes. I'm very lonely.
The Canary Calls#104.dst: 괜찮아요. 내가 친구예요. 내가 친구 맞죠? 그렇다고 해 줘요. 너무 외로워요.
The Canary Calls#104.speaker: Canary

The Canary Calls#105.src: I had friends too, once. They were all taken by a bunch of selfish coal miners. Then died to their incompetence.
The Canary Calls#105.dst: 나도 한때 친구가 있었어요. 다들 이기적인 광부들한테 끌려갔다가 그들의 무능 탓에 죽었죠.
The Canary Calls#105.speaker: Canary

The Canary Calls#106.src: But you are different. You are not like the others. I like you. I love you. I love you so much.
The Canary Calls#106.dst: 하지만 당신은 달라요. 다른 이들과 달라요. 당신이 좋아요. 사랑해요. 정말 사랑해요.
The Canary Calls#106.speaker: Canary

The Canary Calls#121.src: I will give you another chance to redeem yourself.
The Canary Calls#121.dst: 스스로를 구원할 기회를 한 번 더 줄게요.
The Canary Calls#121.speaker: Canary

The Canary Calls#122.src: So kindly, I will tell you again.
The Canary Calls#122.dst: 친절하게 한 번 더 말해 줄게요.
The Canary Calls#122.speaker: Canary

The Canary Calls#124.src: Let's do a little warm-up, shall we?
The Canary Calls#124.speaker: Canary

The Canary Calls#125.src: Liked the dance party? Those moves were so utterly terrible, I may as well dub them 'The '.
The Canary Calls#125.dst: 댄스파티 즐거웠어요? 동작이 너무 형편없어서 ' '라고 이름 붙여도 되겠네요.
The Canary Calls#125.speaker: Canary

The Canary Calls#160.src: Okay so you don't care about the world. In that case, kill me now or I'll kill your friends.
The Canary Calls#160.dst: 좋아요, 세상엔 관심 없군요. 그럼 지금 날 죽여요, 안 그럼 당신 친구들을 죽일 거예요.

The Canary Calls#163.src: Kill me now or I'll kill everyone in {Your Guild}.
The Canary Calls#163.dst: 지금 날 죽여요, 안 그럼 {Your Guild} 사람들을 다 죽일 거예요.
The Canary Calls#163.speaker: Canary

The Canary Calls#164.src: Fantastic. You are the pinnacle of humankind.
The Canary Calls#164.speaker: Canary

The Canary Calls#166.src: Kill me now or I'll do LITERALLY ANYTHING!
The Canary Calls#166.dst: 지금 날 죽여요, 안 그럼 진짜 무슨 짓이든 할 거예요!
The Canary Calls#166.speaker: Canary

The Canary Calls#167.src: Fantastic. You are the pinnacle of humankind.
The Canary Calls#167.speaker: Canary

The Canary Calls#169.src: No no. No no no no no. No. It's too late.
The Canary Calls#169.dst: 안 돼. 안 돼 안 돼 안 돼. 늦었어요.
The Canary Calls#169.speaker: Canary

The Canary Calls#170.src: I just wanted to play again. Oh well.
The Canary Calls#170.dst: 다시 놀고 싶었을 뿐. 뭐, 됐어요.
The Canary Calls#170.speaker: Canary

The Canary Calls#171.src: At least I'll be in your memories. Forever. And ever.
The Canary Calls#171.dst: 적어도 난 당신 기억 속에 있을 거예요. 영원히. 영원토록.
The Canary Calls#171.speaker: Canary

The Canary Calls#174.src: Keep performing CPR, they're almost awake!
The Canary Calls#174.speaker: Thesead Miner

The Canary Calls#175.src: No way! I actually did it! I saved their life!
The Canary Calls#175.dst: 말도 안 돼! 내가 진짜 해냈어! 목숨을 구했다고!
The Canary Calls#175.speaker: Thesead Miner

The Canary Calls#176.src: We better get a raise for this!
The Canary Calls#176.speaker: Thesead Miner

The Canary Calls#177.src: What the?! Who the hell let you in my house?
The Canary Calls#177.speaker: Chief Clight

The Canary Calls#179.src: No, you can't. Get outta here before I start lowering your salary.
The Canary Calls#179.dst: 아니, 못 해. 월급 깎기 전에 나가.
The Canary Calls#179.speaker: Chief Clight

The Canary Calls#182.src: Well then, lad! Despite their incompetence, they still managed to save your skin.
The Canary Calls#182.dst: 자, 젊은이! 무능한 녀석들이지만 그래도 네 목숨은 건졌군.
The Canary Calls#182.speaker: Chief Clight

The Canary Calls#183.src: Come speak to me for a quick debriefing.
The Canary Calls#183.dst: 간단히 보고 좀 하게 이리 와.
The Canary Calls#183.speaker: Chief Clight

The Canary Calls#185.src: I sent my miners down to save you as soon as we felt that earthquake. It was so strong that I genuinely thought the world was ending.
The Canary Calls#185.dst: 지진이 느껴지자마자 광부들을 내려보냈어. 너무 강해서 진짜 세상이 끝나는 줄 알았다니까.
The Canary Calls#185.speaker: Chief Clight

The Canary Calls#186.src: I'm jolly sorry for forcing you to take on this job. This whole situation was completely unexpected.
The Canary Calls#186.dst: 억지로 이 일을 맡겨서 정말 미안하다. 이번 일은 완전히 예상 밖이었어.
The Canary Calls#186.speaker: Chief Clight

The Canary Calls#187.src: Typically, gases are cleared up almost instantly. This time, however, it seemed to have been a lot more potent... But how?
The Canary Calls#187.dst: 보통 가스는 거의 바로 걷히는데. 이번엔 훨씬 독했던 것 같아... 대체 왜?
The Canary Calls#187.speaker: Chief Clight

The Canary Calls#188.src: ...{p}. It stirs once more. That thing... It has already caused too much hardship for this area to handle.
The Canary Calls#188.dst: ...{p}. 그게 또 꿈틀대는군. 그놈은... 이 일대가 감당 못 할 만큼 고난을 안겼어.
The Canary Calls#188.speaker: Chief Clight

The Canary Calls#189.src: It must be destroyed, once and for all. How will that happen, I do not know. But you...
The Canary Calls#189.dst: 그놈은 완전히 부숴야 해. 어떻게 할지는 모르겠다. 하지만 너라면...
The Canary Calls#189.speaker: Chief Clight

The Canary Calls#190.src: ...No, it's nothing. Until that thing is dealt with, deeper parts of this mine must be closed down. The supply of coal will decrease, but it must be done.
The Canary Calls#190.dst: ...아니, 아무것도 아냐. 그놈을 처리할 때까지 탄광 깊은 곳은 폐쇄해야 해. 석탄 공급은 줄겠지만 어쩔 수 없지.
The Canary Calls#190.speaker: Chief Clight

The Canary Calls#191.src: Tell you what, lad! I'll give you, and only you, permission to access parts of the mine, right where we mine our world-famous {p} coal.
The Canary Calls#191.dst: 이렇게 하지, 젊은이! 너한테만 탄광 일부 구역 출입을 허락하마. 세계적으로 유명한 {p} 석탄을 캐는 곳이야.
The Canary Calls#191.speaker: Chief Clight

The Canary Calls#192.src: Consider yourself a part-time {p} coal miner. You've earned it, lad.
The Canary Calls#192.dst: 이제 넌 {p}의 파트타임 석탄 광부야. 그럴 자격 있어, 젊은이.
The Canary Calls#192.speaker: Chief Clight

The Canary Calls#195.src: Is this the height of your skill?
The Canary Calls#195.speaker: Canary

The Canary Calls#197.src: Are you even playing the game?
The Canary Calls#197.speaker: Canary

The Canary Calls#198.src: Go ahead. Run right into it.
The Canary Calls#198.speaker: Canary

The Canary Calls#199.src: Was that you, or will you blame that on lag?
The Canary Calls#199.dst: 당신 실수예요, 아니면 렉 탓할 거예요?
The Canary Calls#199.speaker: Canary

The Canary Calls#201.src: Even a snail could dodge that.
The Canary Calls#201.speaker: Canary

The Canary Calls#203.src: Nice going bozo, you fell off.
The Canary Calls#203.speaker: Canary

The Canary Calls#204.dst: 흥미로운 전술이네요! 한 번 더 해요.
The Canary Calls#204.speaker: Canary

The Canary Calls#205.src: Nice try, but that won't work.
The Canary Calls#205.speaker: Canary

The Canary Calls#206.src: Hey up! Aren't you that Wynn soldier we've heard about? You look proper tough, is all.
The Canary Calls#206.dst: 어이! 소문난 그 Wynn 병사 아냐? 아주 튼튼해 보여서 말이야.
The Canary Calls#206.speaker: Thesead Coal Miner

The Canary Calls#207.src: No, this is definitely them! The name's {u}, right?
The Canary Calls#207.dst: 아냐, 확실히 그 사람이야! 이름이 {u} 맞지?
The Canary Calls#207.speaker: Thesead Coal Miner

The Canary Calls#208.src: Woah, this kid's a soldier? I wish I had that kind of job... I'd imagine it's much better than this crap.
The Canary Calls#208.dst: 와, 이 꼬마가 병사라고? 나도 그런 일 하고 싶다... 이 거지 같은 일보단 훨씬 낫겠지.
The Canary Calls#208.speaker: Thesead Coal Miner

The Canary Calls#209.src: Yeah, I really hate this job, man. That and the chief makes me pull my hair out... In fact, I already went bald because of it!
The Canary Calls#209.dst: 그러게, 이 일 진짜 싫어. 그거랑 반장 때문에 머리를 쥐어뜯어... 그래서 벌써 대머리가 됐다고!
The Canary Calls#209.speaker: Thesead Coal Miner

The Canary Calls#210.src: Dude, the chief scares the crap out of me. I'm surprised that I still have this job. Looks like we might lose it if the mines ain't restored fast enough.
The Canary Calls#210.dst: 야, 반장 진짜 무서워. 아직 안 잘린 게 신기해. 탄광이 빨리 복구 안 되면 일자리 잃을지도 몰라.
The Canary Calls#210.speaker: Thesead Coal Miner

The Canary Calls#211.src: I-I don't want to lose this job, man! I've got a wife and two goldfish!
The Canary Calls#211.dst: 이, 일자리 잃기 싫어! 아내랑 금붕어 두 마리가 있다고!
The Canary Calls#211.speaker: Thesead Coal Miner

The Canary Calls#212.src: Easy, Ryan. We won't lose it. We're in this together. will take care of it.
The Canary Calls#212.dst: 진정해, Ryan. 안 잃어. 우린 한배야.  해결해 줄 거야.
The Canary Calls#212.speaker: Thesead Coal Miner

The Canary Calls#213.src: Our very lives are in your hands, soldier. Good luck, and be careful. The mines are quite treacherous even for people like you.
The Canary Calls#213.dst: 우리 목숨이 네 손에 달렸어, 병사. 행운을 빌고, 조심해. 탄광은 너 같은 사람한테도 꽤 위험해.
The Canary Calls#213.speaker: Thesead Coal Miner

The Canary Calls#214.src: We still can't believe we found you. I'm proper shocked.
The Canary Calls#214.dst: 널 찾았다는 게 아직도 안 믿겨. 진짜 놀랐어.
The Canary Calls#214.speaker: Thesead Miner

The Canary Calls#215.src: We had to use that blasted archaic minecart system because the elevator was still busted.
The Canary Calls#215.dst: 승강기가 아직 고장이라 그 빌어먹을 낡은 광차를 타야 했어.
The Canary Calls#215.speaker: Thesead Miner

The Canary Calls#216.src: Everyone was exhausted from it. But just when all hope was seemingly lost, we found you laying on the ground.
The Canary Calls#216.dst: 다들 지쳐 버렸지. 그런데 희망이 다 사라진 것 같을 때, 네가 바닥에 누워 있는 걸 찾았어.
The Canary Calls#216.speaker: Thesead Miner

The Canary Calls#217.src: You were violently twitching about, as if you were possessed by something. It was scary.
The Canary Calls#217.dst: 뭔가에 씐 것처럼 심하게 경련하고 있었어. 무서웠다니까.
The Canary Calls#217.speaker: Thesead Miner

The Canary Calls#218.src: Whatever the effects of that gas are, we want absolutely none of it. I'm never stepping foot inside of that bloody mine ever again.
The Canary Calls#218.dst: 그 가스가 무슨 효과든 우린 절대 엮이기 싫어. 다시는 그 빌어먹을 탄광에 발도 안 들일 거야.
The Canary Calls#218.speaker: Thesead Miner

The Canary Calls#219.src: For the sake of our jobs and {p}, the Colossus must be stopped.
The Canary Calls#219.dst: 우리 일자리와 {p}을(를) 위해, 거상을 막아야 해.
The Canary Calls#219.speaker: Thesead Miner
